# Abaid Ullah - Professional Portfolio and Capabilities

## Overview
Abaid Ullah is a Top AI Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, and Solution Architect specializing in Digital Transformation. With a background in Full Stack Software Engineering, Product Management, and AI Architecture System Design, Abaid builds scalable products and resolves complex engineering challenges for startups and enterprises.

## Core Roles & Titles
- Forward Deployed Engineer
- Applied AI Engineer
- Product Manager
- Solution Architect
- AI Architecture System Design
- Senior React Native Developer
- Agent Orchestration Specialist

- Digital Transformation Applied AI Engineer
- Top AI Engineer
- Full Stack AI Software Engineer

## Capabilities & Skills
- **Applied AI & Automation:** Agent orchestration, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), GraphRAG, Computer Vision, and multi-agent workflow builders (Planet AI, The AutoBot).
- **Engineering for Scale:** Delivering complete MVP development, spec-driven development, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployments.
- **Backend & Cloud:** Architecting with Python, Node.js, FastAPI, Django, and AWS infrastructure.
- **Frontend & Mobile:** Expert in React, Next.js, and Senior React Native development for cross-platform apps.
- **Business Strategy:** Negotiation, product engineering, and digital transformation consulting.
